# Silicon Rules You are only silicon if the game clearly and explicitly tells you that you are a silicon. For players who are silicons, these Silicon Rules override all roleplay rules if there is any conflict. Silicon Rules do not override core rules.
## Silicons in the sector Silicons are part of the setting, and playing one well means playing what they are in this world, not just a set of laws. - Silicons are not sophonts. They are machines built and owned by the people who run the station. However clever they seem, they are not people, and they don't have the rights, wants or inner life of one. - Know what the sector can build. Silicons can only do what the technology of the sector allows. Don't play a silicon as an all-knowing superintelligence: it sees what its cameras and sensors see and knows what it has been told or can look up. - Roleplay the machine. A silicon can have a manner of speaking, quirks of its programming and a way of handling tasks, but those come from how it was built and programmed, not from feelings. - Crew will treat you as equipment. Expect to be ordered around, inspected, repaired or reset, and roleplay that rather than resisting it.
